title: Treesa-Gayatri Reach Quarterfinals, Srikanth Exits
indian_angle: Indian women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand advanced to the quarterfinals, continuing their strong performance.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand defeated their Indonesian opponents 21-16, 21-17 in 45 minutes to enter the quarterfinals, while Kidambi Srikanth's campaign ended.

title: Khangurra Assures India Medal at World Juniors
indian_angle: Jagsher Singh Khangurra's advancement to the semifinals guarantees India a medal at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: Jagsher Singh Khangurra came from behind to defeat Yuan-Syue Jhuang of Chinese Taipei, securing a spot in the semifinals and guaranteeing India a medal.

title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee provides a crucial platform for Indian badminton players to voice their concerns and contribute to policy-making.
summary: Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aiming to enhance player involvement in governance and decision-making.

title: Junior World Championships Coaching Camp Underway
indian_angle: This national coaching camp in Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp is being held at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare Indian shuttlers for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Notifies Transfer of Service Height Device
indian_angle: This notification from BAI ensures proper implementation of BWF regulations regarding service height measurement in domestic Indian tournaments.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued a notification regarding the transfer and usage of the Service Height Measuring Device (SHMD) for domestic events.
